audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Camille or Skill every row from Level 2 to first item, while whys[1] through whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early and mid all say Mordekaiser owns exactly those stages — and the packet levelChart reads Skill / Mordekaiser x5 / Camille.
audit.why: Ten strings on the page said Mordekaiser wins levels 2-5 while the chart above them said Camille. The 55.11% win rate over 626 games backs the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Camille in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, phases[3] and phases[6] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot was the tracked cooldown on nine surfaces with no duration and no mention that it needs terrain.
audit.why: Riot’s E text says she pulls herself to a wall — without one in reach she has no engage and no escape.
audit.corrected: Hookshot written as 16s at rank 1 and wall-dependent in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Adaptive Defenses was never mentioned. Her passive shields her against the damage type that hit her — against a full-magic Mordekaiser that is a magic shield off every single auto she lands on you.
audit.why: It is the single most important interaction in this matchup and the page spent its ability text on "her engage/escape" instead. Tactical Sweep’s outer-half heal was also unanswered.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d, whys[6] and spikes[3].text now state the magic shield; report[8].t adds Grievous Wounds before Tactical Sweep’s heal decides long trades.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Camille must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Q ranks make isolated hits massive and Darkness Rise out-DPSes her; pull her back into the aura every time she Hookshots off.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Camille's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Two items in, Precision Protocol's second hit is true damage and Adaptive Defenses shields her against your magic on every auto, so the extended fight she loses early is now hers.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/escape. Punish the cooldown. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1 and it needs a wall to grapple. Fight her in open lane.

edits.before: Her engage/escape. Punish the cooldown. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is 16s at rank 1 and needs a wall nearby. Step up once she has spent it.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hookshot only works off terrain — in the open lane she has no engage.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Adaptive Defenses gives her a magic shield off every auto on you, so opening a trade into a fresh shield is the softest damage you will deal.

edits.before: Track Camille's Hookshot: Her engage/escape. Punish the cooldown. When it is down — R her — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Hookshot: 16s at rank 1 and it needs a wall to grapple. In open lane she cannot engage — that is your window.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment, then Riftmaker, plus Grievous Wounds before Tactical Sweep's heal decides long trades; boots Plated Steelcaps. First back: Bami's (≈900-1300g).

edits.before: Two items in, her Q/W true damage ignores your HP and shields while Hookshot kites your aura — she reclaims the duel.
edits.after: Two items in, Precision Protocol's second hit is true damage and her passive shields your magic while Hookshot kites the aura.

edits.before: Camille's window — her Q empowered-auto true damage and W cone cut through your HP-stacking, and Hookshot mobility dances her out of the aura once she's itemized.
edits.after: Camille's window — Precision Protocol's delayed second hit lands true damage, Adaptive Defenses eats your magic every auto, and Hookshot dances her out of the aura.

edits.before: Farm safely to two items where Q/W true damage and her W heal flip the extended fight she loses early
edits.after: Farm to two items where Precision Protocol's true damage and Tactical Sweep's outer-half heal flip the fight

notes: DISAGREEMENT WITH THE MIRROR, flagged deliberately. The camille-side audit kept its rows (Camille winning levels 2-3) and rewrote its whys to match, reasoning from two strings on that page. From this side the evidence runs the other way: the packet levelChart, a 55.11% Mordekaiser win rate over 626 games, and ten separate strings on this page all say Mordekaiser owns levels 2 through first item. I moved the rows rather than gut ten strings. mirror-fix.js will have to pick a side — this one is the better-supported read. Also not asserted: Mordekaiser Q’s derived grounding flag, and the derived channel/untargetable flags on The Hextech Ultimatum, none of which Riot’s descriptions support. suspectNames flagged "Bank Indestructible" and "Land Realm of Death" — both false positives, those are real Mordekaiser ability names.
